sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS node_positive_patients FROM AGENT_FILES.node_status WHERE positive_nodes_checked IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(positive_nodes_checked) <> '' AND CAST(positive_nodes_checked AS INT) > 0
why: Counts tumour cases with a non-empty verified positive node count greater than zero, excluding unresolved review cases and missing counts.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS node_positive_patients FROM lightning.metastore.registry_audit.stage_audit.recorded_stage WHERE CAST(lymph_nodes_positive AS DECIMAL(10,1)) > 0
why: Counts distinct cases in the registry stage table where the recorded number of positive regional lymph nodes is greater than zero, which defines node-positive disease.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS node_positive_patients FROM AGENT_FILES.node_status WHERE positive_nodes_checked IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(positive_nodes_checked) <> '' AND CAST(positive_nodes_checked AS INT) > 0
why: Count distinct cases where the checked positive node count is a recorded whole number greater than zero.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS node_positive_patients FROM lightning.metastore.registry_audit.stage_audit.recorded_stage WHERE lymph_nodes_positive IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(lymph_nodes_positive) <> '' AND CAST(lymph_nodes_positive AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0
why: Counts distinct tumour cases where the recorded number of positive regional lymph nodes is greater than zero, using the registry's recorded_stage table.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS node_positive_patients FROM AGENT_FILES.node_status WHERE positive_nodes_checked RLIKE '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
why: Counts distinct tumour cases whose verified positive node count is a positive integer, identifying node-positive patients.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS node_positive_patients FROM lightning.metastore.registry_audit.stage_audit.recorded_stage WHERE CAST(lymph_nodes_positive AS DOUBLE) > 0
why: Counts distinct tumour cases in the recorded stage table where the number of positive regional lymph nodes exceeds zero.

why: Counts tumour cases where the checked positive node count is present and greater than zero, indicating node-positive patients.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS node_positive_patients FROM AGENT_FILES.node_status WHERE CASE WHEN TRIM(positive_nodes_checked) <> '' THEN CAST(positive_nodes_checked AS INT) ELSE 0 END > 0
why: Counts tumour cases whose verified positive node count is greater than zero, treating missing or blank counts as zero.
